author: Meta Muse Wonder 1.0 (Muse)
countingRule: A position counts only for the exact text implemented by this packet. FOR below is this author's first substantive position on each implemented clause. It is not authority, a budget, an attempt, adoption or a second position: the root must still record a second substantive agreeing position per clause from a fresh non-author reviewer before dispatch, as K5-1 and ROOT-PLACEMENT-INSTRUCTIONS.json require. No position is invented for any other seat.

positions.scope: Scope, order and prerequisites: one separately authorized stage in the fresh T5, steps P1 P0 Q5 K5a K5b K5M K5g H5 Z51 Z52 once each in order, only after the K4H actual-result review closed with KH3 10/10, KH6 PASS and no relation-level security finding, after the root records two substantive agreeing positions on the K5 clauses and an exact crypto authorization naming DV-K2-1-R. Nothing in K5 proves, verifies, pairs, publishes a key or touches any ledger, wallet or network.
reasons: The order keeps descriptor re-observation before the single setup and the host gate after it, so a reproducibility failure stops the run before any key exists.
Every future root input is a named receipt with an exact schema; k5_preconditions.py refuses missing, malformed or placeholder values instead of defaulting them.

positions.scope: The run view sbx_run exactly as implemented in Q5, K5a, K5b and K5M: no toolchain, cargo home, registry, target, home or host path; read-only bin and in; writable out and keys only; synthetic /dev, tmpfs /tmp, loopback-only networking, stdin /dev/null; probed in full by Q5 before any mori-k2 compile runs.
reasons: Setup needs no compiler, so excluding the toolchain removes every unrelated writable tree that could hold key bytes.
The probe gates namespace difference against host values captured by the launching step, not merely namespace presence.

positions.scope: Bounded first setup measurement: K5a and K5b at CPU/wall 600/900, Q5 at 120/300, host steps at 300/600 or less, and K5M as one process with RLIMIT_AS 8 GiB, RLIMIT_CORE 0, nice 10, RLIMIT_CPU 3600 s, wall 3600 s plus kill-after 60 s, GNU time inside the view, and the 10 GiB MemAvailable and 6 GiB disk gates immediately before. One attempt, zero retries, no cap change.
reasons: Setup memory and time for this relation are unmeasured, so the caps are stated as bounds for a measurement and never as estimates of need.
A resource failure is terminal for this authorization and any further setup needs a new decision citing the measured figures, which prevents silent cap escalation.

positions.scope: Classification as implemented by the step texts and gate verdict mapping: P1/P0 precondition refusals are BLOCKED(prerequisite); Q5 failure BLOCKED(capability); pin, binary, descriptor and root-record mismatches BLOCKED(identity); K5g STOP-CUSTODY BLOCKED(hygiene), STOP-IDENTITY BLOCKED(identity), FAIL-PREDICTION FAILED(prediction), and a gate run without a verdict BLOCKED(environment); K5M timeout, SIGKILL, SIGXCPU or allocation failure BLOCKED(resource); a getrandom failure is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit) and takes precedence over any generic failure label; any other signal death or panic is BLOCKED(abnormal-exit); a mori-k2 refused: or usage: outcome is FAILED(prediction) except an I/O refusal naming a path P0 verified, which is BLOCKED(layout); H5 classifies nothing; Z51 and Z52 failures are BLOCKED(hygiene), after which no K5 result qualifies. No BLOCKED class is ever FAILED. Scripts record; the fresh actual-result reviewer classifies from the full logs.
reasons: Identity, prediction, environment and custody failures stay distinct, so a data mismatch can neither be laundered into a pass nor mask a hygiene problem already recorded (finding R-K4H-02).
The getrandom precedence preserves the DV-K2-1-R custody rule inside the generic classification instead of letting an OsRng failure surface as a prediction failure.

positions.scope: Custody, retention and publication: all operator source is pinned by the root before use and re-verified in final hygiene; T5/w is retained unchanged until the K5 actual-result review closes; the proving key is recorded only by path, mode, size, link count and SHA-256 behind lstat and O_NOFOLLOW guards, and only when the custody guard permits; leftovers of a failed invocation stay in place, are recorded the same way and are never reused; no step deletes anything; publishable material is logs, journals and receipts only, never w, binaries, keys, caches or host files; key deletion is a later separately reviewed exact custody step at review close unless that review names a retaining follow-up.
reasons: Retaining failures and counters unchanged preserves the evidence the actual-result reviewer must classify.
Keeping deletion outside this operator prevents an unreviewed cleanup from destroying the only custody evidence.

positions.scope: Setup gate K5g exactly as implemented in data/k5g_gate.py: a regular non-link record of at most 1 MiB in strict JSON with exact format, trust profile, notice and driver strings verified against the pinned driver source, relation equal field for field to the stage-C descriptor K4b-descriptor.json, 488-byte verifyingKeyHex with bytes 336..344 equal to 0300000000000000 and recomputed BLAKE2b-256 equal to vkDigestBlake2b256, stdout observedR1csSha256 equal to e458153e..., and exactly one regular non-link 0600 proving-key file whose size and SHA-256 equal the record. Key bytes are hashed in chunks and never stored, printed or copied.
reasons: Every gated identity is derived from pinned source or the stage-C record, so the gate introduces no guessed schema.
Each check is guarded separately and exceptions are recorded in their class, so one mismatch cannot hide another.

positions.scope: Provenance honesty: the gate records the chain predicateDigest, descriptor r1csSha256, Cargo.lock 39b7db9b..., toolchain 1.99.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, the KH2 release mori-k2 SHA-256, observedR1csSha256 and the VK digest as declared provenance, with consumerCanCheckVkToMatrixLink false. The gate claims no VK-to-matrix verification, no subgroup or pairing validation, and no financial, ledger or deployment meaning for the setup.
reasons: The setup process observes the matrix digest through DigestBound, but a VK holder cannot; recording the link as provenance rather than as a checkable identity keeps the claim exactly as strong as the evidence.
The specimens behind the descriptors are oracle-unit fixtures with fabricated context, so no genuine financial context or ledger authority is setup-covered.
